name: AXM Human Control Binding Observatory
actions: verify graph-bounded HTML and JavaScript source hashes before analysis
inventory entry HTML buttons links inputs selects textareas forms summaries and details
separate inline native selector-reference and static binding patterns
observe names duplicate ids disabled and hidden declarations without accessibility verdicts
prepare one question-only module control review packet
summary: Read-only static inventory of human-facing entry controls and bounded binding evidence over a verified entry resource graph.
notes: It uses bounded text patterns, not a DOM or full parser. It never loads a browser, clicks controls, proves behavior/accessibility/routes, changes source, grants permission, installs, or changes CANON.
